name: Frontend UI
description: The React/TypeScript single-page application (CRA) — App and UploadPage components, the axios API client, global styles, and the static HTML shell that let a user submit a YouTube URL and view the generated course, quiz, and retention plan.

name: Backend API & Orchestration
description: The FastAPI application and its request-handling logic — the app entry point, the course-generation router, the LangGraph agentic pipeline (Gemini/Groq calls), video frame extraction, S3 upload helpers, and the SSE progress broadcaster.

name: Data Layer
description: Persistence for generated courses — the SQLAlchemy async engine/session setup, the Course ORM model, the async CRUD functions, and the one-shot database schema initializer run at container startup.

name: Infrastructure & Deployment
description: Container and orchestration definitions for the whole stack — backend and frontend Dockerfiles, the docker-compose services (Postgres, MinIO, Jaeger, backend, frontend, and their init jobs), the nginx static-file config, and the backend container entrypoint script.

name: Configuration
description: Project and build configuration — the root and frontend npm manifests, the frontend TypeScript compiler config, the PWA manifest, the .env template for the compose stack, and tooling configs for Serena and Understand-Anything.

name: Documentation
description: Project-facing documentation and dependency manifests describing how to run the stack and what the backend depends on — the root and frontend READMEs, the crawler policy, and the annotated Python requirements file.
